SELECT T1.code_module, AVG(T2.score) FROM assessments AS T1 INNER JOIN studentAssessment AS T2 ON T1.id_assessment = T2.id_assessment INNER JOIN studentInfo AS T3 ON T1.code_module = T3.code_module AND T1.code_presentation = T3.code_presentation AND T2.id_student = T3.id_student WHERE T1.assessment_type = 'TMA' AND (T3.final_result = 'Pass' OR T3.final_result = 'Distinction') GROUP BY T1.code_module
